finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed at [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6), old key still accepted.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags undefined, not `false`. Fixed at [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The rest is noise. 8 deprecation warnings, mostly `DEP0142` and `DEP0198` in `src/legacy/`.

Next: clean up those legacy deprecations if you want zero warnings.
